errors.text_span: По хоризонталната ос са представени периодите
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the periods are on the horizontal axis. The horizontal axis shows percentages, while the periods are on the vertical axis.
The description incorrectly states that the percentages are on the vertical axis. The vertical axis shows time periods, while the percentages are on the horizontal axis.
The first time period listed on the chart is 1990-1995, not 1996-1995. This typo appears twice in the description.
The shortest bar, corresponding to the period 1990-1995, has a value of approximately 16%, not 12%.
The bar for the period 2013-2018 reaches approximately 29%, as it is visibly short of the 30% mark, not 31%.

errors.text_span: Степента на запълване на стълбовете е еднаква във всички периоди.
errors.evidence: This statement claims that the 'degree of filling' (i.e., the length of the bars) is the same for all periods. This is factually incorrect, as the bars have different lengths to represent different percentages, which is the primary information the chart conveys.
